function.name: convert_smpl2mhr
function.description: Convert SMPL(X) meshes or model parameters to MHR model parameters.

smpl_vertices.description: The vertex positions of the SMPL(X) model. Can be a torch tensor, numpy array or None.

smpl_parameters.description: The parameters of the SMPL(X) model. Can be a dictionary of torch tensors or None

single_identity.description: Whether to use a single identity for all results. If True, a common identity parameters will be optimized

exclude_expression.description: Whether to exclude expression parameters from the fitting. If True, the function will optimize for body shape and pose parameters only

is_tracking.description: Whether the input SMPL data is a temporal sequence. If True, the function will use the previous frame's parameters as the initial parameters for the next frame.

return_mhr_meshes.description: Whether to return the MHR meshes. If True, the function will return a list of MHR meshes.

return_mhr_parameters.description: Whether to return the MHR parameters. If True, the function will return a dictionary of MHR parameters.

return_mhr_vertices.description: Whether to return the MHR vertices. If True, the function will return a numpy array of MHR vertices.

return_fitting_errors.description: Whether to return fitting errors. If True, the function will return errors for each frame.

batch_size.description: Number of frames to process in each batch. If None, uses the default batch size.

smpl_parameters.description: The parameters of the SMPL(X) model. Can be a dictionary of torch tensors or None

single_identity.description: Whether to use a single identity for all results. If True, a common identity parameters will be optimized

exclude_expression.description: Whether to exclude expression parameters from the fitting. If True, the function will optimize for body shape and pose parameters only

is_tracking.description: Whether the input SMPL data is a temporal sequence. If True, the function will use the previous frame's parameters as the initial parameters for the next frame.

return_mhr_meshes.description: Whether to return the MHR meshes. If True, the function will return a list of MHR meshes.

return_mhr_parameters.description: Whether to return the MHR parameters. If True, the function will return a dictionary of MHR parameters.

return_mhr_vertices.description: Whether to return the MHR vertices. If True, the function will return a numpy array of MHR vertices.

return_fitting_errors.description: Whether to return fitting errors. If True, the function will return errors for each frame.

batch_size.description: Number of frames to process in each batch. If None, uses the default batch size.
